question: What lactic acid and acetic acid concentrations did the well-fermented alfalfa silage group (LPGood) have?
rendered:
A Comparative Study of Forward Osmosis Systems: An Integrated Experimental, Modeling, and Techno-Economic Analysis, page 14
and Fermentation Quality Divergence of Alfalfa Silage within the Same Batch: Insights from 16S rRNA Sequencing and Untargeted Metabolomics, page 3

The LPGood group had markedly (p < 0.05) higher lactic acid (LA) and acetic acid (AA) concentrations than the LPBad group.

Lactic acid (LA): 8.0 g/kg DM
Acetic acid (AA): not specified, but higher than the LPBad group.
